training.recovery_selection: latest saved recovery by step only, never validation score
training.sampling: Microbatch 0 alternates color quartets and four navigation rows. Quartets: 50% new views/50% retained quartets. Navigation rows: balanced colors, 70% original near-goal pools (equal randomized/retention domains), 30% visible new views. Microbatch 1 uses two opposite-velocity pairs except every fifth step, which retains takeoff, landing, turn and hover examples. Pair domains: 50% new views/25% original randomized/25% retained. Tasks cycle 2..6. Retained takeoff samples are 50% grounded. Color quartets share noise at t=1. Velocity pairs share noise/time within each pair, with t=1 on even steps and sampled time on odd steps.
training.loss: Flow matching on six normalized action channels, weights [8,8,1,1,1,1], divided by their sum; runtime units and normalization unchanged.
training.data: Existing 6408 images retained plus 2000 new training-only views; opposite-own-velocity pairs added without changing existing labels.
training.primitive_sampling: 40% of all examples are state pairs; 10% retained primitive examples; navigation is 50%.
training.frozen_backbone: All vision-language parameters; train action expert and state/action projections only. Verify frozen parameter digest before and after training.
training.image_domains: Explicit per-image domains; new views are appended after the 6408 existing image IDs.

rear_edge.target_actor: alternating geometry identities; both clothing assignments rendered

data_generation.visibility_rule: Existing visible() for navigation labels; never reject a rendered pose after seeing a model result

own_velocity_pairing.invariant: Same image, prompt and other own-state values; horizontal velocity changes sign only
own_velocity_pairing.teacher: Existing train04 teacher, including -0.8 times captured own velocity for tasks 2/4/5/6; landing unchanged

reuse_final_round_reason: Round 2 has never been exposed to policy inference or flight. Its layouts, seeds, counts and criteria remain unchanged.
evaluation: dev 8/8, exposed stress >=14/16 with >=7/8 per color and >=3/4 per layout, regression 5/5, known-failure 1/1, then fixed final-step selection and fresh matched 16 per model plus 64 color outputs.
frozen: Runtime controller, gains, detector, mission manager, scorer, action units and English instructions
hypotheses_not_proven: Additional rear/edge and all-heading training images improve coverage.
Opposite-state pairs reduce appearance shortcuts and improve imitation of braking labels.
